title: The 11 Fundamental Duties every citizen should know
excerpt: Article 51A of the Constitution lists our duties. Here is a plain-language look at what they ask of us.
body:
Rights are what the nation promises us. **Duties are what we promise the nation.** Article 51A of the Constitution lists eleven Fundamental Duties.

## In short

1. Respect the Constitution, its ideals, the National Flag and the National Anthem.
2. Cherish the noble ideals of our freedom struggle.
3. Uphold the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India.
4. Defend the country and render national service when called upon.
5. Promote harmony and brotherhood, and renounce practices that demean women.
6. Value and preserve our rich composite culture.
7. Protect and improve the natural environment.
8. Develop scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry.
9. Safeguard public property and abjure violence.
10. Strive for excellence in individual and collective activity.
11. Provide opportunities for education to one's child between the ages of six and fourteen years.

This is a summary for awareness. Read the exact text of Article 51A on the official government portal.
